opening_rules: open on a legible status boundary or humiliation
make kindness cost something before hidden status is revealed
use one concrete repeatable object as the moral test instrument
let an innocent child/worker/ally reveal truth before power intervenes
pay off with public reversal plus changed ritual or relationship, not only wealth
introduce surrogate family or non-romantic care before high-status romantic rescue
make hidden wealth create a post-reveal trust wound, then repair it through changed conduct and protagonist choice
show the protagonist economic capability chain through visible objects, savings, loans, work, or repeated service rituals
define a spatial status grammar: who sits, kneels, serves, enters, or eats at the table
use an innocent child or powerless ally as a physical truth instrument rather than an exposition device
make circular inversion change the meaning of the original space or object, not merely restore status
risk_patterns: abstract goodness without a physical object
copycat beggar/billionaire packaging without a distinct object or wound
hidden billionaire reveal treated as instant reward rather than consent/trust rupture
wealth or marriage payoff that erases the protagonist economic agency chain
child ally used as decoration rather than evidence of relational truth
thumbnail_rules: show class/status contrast in one glance
include the concrete test object when possible
make the vulnerable worker or innocent ally emotionally central
avoid generic luxury romance if the real engine is moral testing

input/reference video billing can increase cost on some providers
voice, music, edit, QA, and labor are excluded
recheck exact provider pricing/terms before any spend
production_rules: do not generate the full film linearly; decompose into shots
validate character consistency with a cheap fixed smoke pack first
use expensive models only for hero/motion-critical shots
track actual generated seconds vs final seconds as a KPI
